text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council to amend the existing parking regulations on the north side of Downsview Park Boulevard, between Keele Street and the east end of Downsview Park Boulevard in order to address the community concerns regarding the lack of parking on Downsview Park Boulevard. The proposed parking amendment will provide three-hours maximum parking to access the Downsview Park and there will be no impact to traffic operations.

North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition at all times, on the north side of Downsview Park Boulevard, between Keele Street and the east end of Downsview Park Boulevard .
